description: Knox was spawned correctly (fire-and-forget), but the plaud-ingest workflow's STATE CHECK protocol surfaces an interactive auth question. In a non-interactive boot context, Knox blocks waiting for controller input. Boot should continue in the background without waiting for auth resolution — plaud-ingest is designed as a fire-and-forget background task that continues even if auth fails or is pending.
correction: Boot protocol: spawn Knox and immediately continue without waiting for Knox to surface questions. Knox should handle auth internally and surface any blocking issues asynchronously (not blocking boot). Update step-01 spawn instruction: do not wait for Agent result. Fire Knox and immediately proceed to step-01.2.
systemic_fix: Change Agent spawn in step-01 to use fire-and-forget pattern: spawn Knox with Agent tool but do NOT wait for result. Boot should continue synchronously. Knox surfaces auth questions to controller asynchronously after boot completes.
